newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's March same-store sales up 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's March same-store sales up 11.5 pct.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said Thursday that same-store sales for the five-week period ended April 5, 1997 were up 11.5 percent versus the comparable period last year.
Total sales for the period rose 29.2 percent to $243.8 million. Kohl's reported March sales last year of $188.8 million.
Year to date, Kohl's said same-store sales rose 9.1 percent, and total sales were up 24.7 percent to $376.8 million. For the period last year, Kohl's reported $302.3 million in total sales.
"Sales were strong in all markets including the eight new stores which opened in the Washington D.C./Baltimore markets during the month," William Kellogg, chairman of Kohl's, said in a statement.
"Due to the shift in Easter it will be important to look at the months of March and April together," he said.
At April 5, Kohl's operated 159 stores compared with 132 stores at the same point last year.
